_comment: Per-theme keyword blacklists (#209 Tier 1). Each entry maps a lower-cased theme slug to a list of substrings; any seed candidate whose title or abstract contains any of these is dropped at the seed phase. The seed-phase implementation-foundation denylist (paperpilot/data/lineage_denylist.json) is theme-INDEPENDENT (Adam, SciPy, PyTorch etc. for every theme); this file is theme-SPECIFIC, capturing the long tail of cross-domain leakage that S2's fieldsOfStudy gate doesn't catch (medical / clinical / bioinformatics surfacing in CS themes via Math FoS). Curated from the 2026-05-27 audit findings.

_format.matching: case-insensitive substring against (title + ' ' + abstract).lower(); any hit = drop
